answer.notes: Title block (top of sheet) identifies the drawing as "Drawing No. ATK/TS/343/ATH-END-3B/SD/TEL-00", Title: ELECTRICAL (PH-11) - PROTOTYPE (END VILLA-3B) UNDER GROUND FLOOR PLAN TELEPHONE/DATA LAYOUT (ACTUAL/MIRROR), Project: VILLA NOVA, PHASE-11 (AMARANTA-3), AT DUBAILAND, DUBAI, U.A.E. The suffix "-00" in the drawing number appears to double as the sheet's own revision, but the fine print in the small REV cell next to the title block could not be enlarged/cropped with the available tool, so this reading (00) has moderate confidence only. A green "APPROVAL STATUS" stamp (with reference number 5109214, dated 15/09/19) sits near the "SHOP DRAWING" label and appears to be a consultant/contractor review stamp, but its printed option checkboxes/letters and which one is marked are too small to read reliably at the available image resolution, so these are left empty/unclear rather than guessed. The "CONSULTANT'S DRAWING REFERENCE" and "MEP COORDINATED DRAWING REFERENCE" tables list multiple referenced drawing numbers with their own Rev columns (mostly "00") - these are referenced drawings, not this sheet's own identity/revision, and only representative examples are listed above (the full tables contain more rows too small to transcribe reliably).

answer.notes: This is a title-block drawing sheet (steel structure "NODE NUMBER REFERENCE PLAN" for a Vehicle Repair Yard), not a submittal/review form, so there is no consultant/client approval decision block with printed options (checkboxes such as Approved/Rejected) present on this page; the phrase "ISSUED FOR APPROVAL & NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION" near the bottom right is a printed status note, not a marked selection, so decision fields are left empty. The title block is printed sideways (rotated 90°) along the left/bottom edge of the sheet in very small text, making some characters hard to distinguish with certainty. The label "AMANA Drawing Number" is immediately followed by a second label "Client Drawing Number", and only one value string ("DL894DN05F/RAS0281", read literally, character ambiguity between D/0/1 possible) appears to follow both labels — it was attributed here to "AMANA Drawing Number" as the sheet's own identity, but it may instead (or also) belong to "Client Drawing Number"; this could not be fully disambiguated at the available resolution. A separate "Project No." field reads "DL-295". "Drawn By", "Checked By" and "Approved By" fields show numeric codes (10221, 10314, 10272) instead of names. The standalone "Revision / 00" box near the top of the title-block strip was taken as the sheet's own revision, distinct from the revision-history row ("00, 26.05.2022, ISSUED FOR APPROVAL") found in the small history table near the bottom-right stamp. Numerous small circled/boxed node reference numbers (e.g. 07, 15, 25, 08, 16, 24, 26, 28, 29, 35, 36, 38, 41) and grid/dimension labels appear on the plan itself but were not individually catalogued due to their small size and count; a representative sample is listed. Issue Date reads "26.05.2022"; Scale reads "As indicated" / "@ ISO A1".
